rules.title: Jump In
rules.description: Transcribed from src/match/rules/jump_in.cpp as spec 13.3 prescribes: a deny on out-of-turn plays (shipped by vanilla as vanilla:turn_order) plus this allow entry rescuing an identical card. The play predicates come from WP7e (plays_identical_to_top = same colour AND value as the discard top). The legacy OnCardPlayed turn steal (setting current_player_index to the jumper) is engine-side: the phase-1 condition vocabulary cannot guard an after:play graph on 'out of turn and identical', so no graph is authored here.
